# R6.8 — RUNNER-CORE (a)+(b): hharness-runner + hh-runner (manifest 261)

- **Branch:** `codex/harnessharness-r6.8` · base `origin/main` @ `6df50e87` (R6.7 tip, PR #301)
- **Merge policy:** OPERATOR — PR opened, not merged.
- **Layer:** engineered — offline-only, USD $0.00; zero production mutations.

## Landed

- `crates/hh-runner/` — package `hharness-runner` (lib + `hh-runner` bin): `coordinator`
  (sole writer of the experiment store root; drives `ExperimentEngine`
  `next → claim → launch → settle` under the spec's `ReattemptPolicy` — no
  scheduler/retry-counter/store of its own), `slot-worker` (one process per
  in-flight attempt; sole writer of its own slot store; ST0–ST7 + seal +
  retained grade attempts + one `hh-experiment-slot/1` blob), `store-probe`
  (cross-process read + second-writer spike legs).
- `disposition.rs` — the closed `withheld{…}` member set (`admission:<r>`
  for `r ∈ AG1–AG9` + the §3.3 ST0/named-hold reasons, `budget`,
  `window_deadline`, `image_drift`, `dataset_private`, `no_candidate`,
  `inert_predicted`, `inert_at_admissible_window`, `infra`, `l1_not_passed`,
  `sealed_until_results`), `end_cause`, `infra:<c>`, `inconclusive{<cause>}`,
  flags, dispositions — strict parse, unknown members refuse (no relabelling).
- `facts.rs` — the §3.3 slot-fact → `OutcomeClass`/disposition map: every
  table row, premature-refusal precedence over a valid reward
  (`inconclusive{infra:budget_reservation}` → `infrastructure_failure`, the
  single replanning class), and the pinned one-to-one Harbor `error_policy`
  cause map.
- `slot_record.rs` — `hh-experiment-slot/1` codec over canonical JSON
  (runner-crate record, not `hh-embed-schema`): full §3.3 sections;
  `costs{model,compute}` are `{schema:"hh-slot-costs/1", ref}` references
  only — a value member refuses; `identity.runner{driver_commit,
  binary_sha256}` stamped on every record.
- `coordinator.rs` — durable-only recovery: launched-but-unsettled attempts
  bind the sealed slot record (subject `lifecycle.run.finished` copies the
  record verbatim + `slot_store{root_digest, run_id, head_hash}`) or close
  `inconclusive{infra:runner_crash}` and replan; `bind_lease`/`take_binding`
  carries the writer lease; claim `WouldBlock` is waited out (the durable
  fence is the re-claim gate — never a runner-side release).
- `worker.rs` — ST0–ST7 over a declared `hh-runner-slot/1` packet:
  provision/phase rows, `submission_seal` proof, `oracle.invoked/verdict`
  grade attempts (≤ declared bound), `hh-experiment-slot/1` blob ref bound
  into the slot run's `lifecycle.run.finished{slot_record_ref, slot_ref}`.
- `packet.rs` — `hh-runner-drive/1` + `hh-runner-slot/1` declared run-input
  records (spec, resolver deposits, fixture recipes, TTLs, parallelism).
- `src/main.rs` — `hh-runner {coordinator|slot-worker|store-probe}`.
- `scripts/check-runner-edges.sh` + `scripts/ci/test-check-runner-edges.sh`
  + ci.yml `Runner K-2 edge check (AR-04)` step — `cargo tree` forbids any
  edge into hh-embed/hh-cli/hosting/kernel/orchestrator/fleet; seeded-edge
  self-test proves the negative leg.
- `docs/adr/ADR-0427-r6.8-runner-placement.md` (AR-04 ruling; dated
  addendum defers live Harbor/O-surface admission to R6.17; fixture channel
  `hh-runner-fixture-verdict/1` is explicitly labelled).
- `tests/r6_8.rs` — AC battery: 2×3×2 fixture experiment end-to-end through
  real `hh-runner` coordinator + slot-worker processes (12 plans settled
  scored, one record per slot); withheld ST0 record; premature-refusal +
  no-replan sweep; kill-point battery (worker killed pre-seal →
  `inconclusive{infra:runner_crash}` + replan attempt 2, never a mid-run
  resume, no duplicate; worker killed post-seal → binds `scored`;
  coordinator death mid-claim → claim TTL lapse → attempt 1 relaunched, no
  duplicate); cross-process read sees the committed prefix under a live
  writer + second-writer `WouldBlock` refusal; no-absolute-path +
  no-file-existence-skip scans.

## Requirement stamping

- Primary: REQ-XB-101 (binary identity stamps — `driver_commit` + binary
  sha256 on every record), REQ-XB-102 (engine drive, no second scheduler),
  REQ-XB-103 (K-2/AR-04 — enforced edge check), REQ-XB-108
  (`hh-experiment-slot/1` per slot, costs references only), REQ-XB-120
  (§3.3 outcome map + Harbor causes), REQ-XB-105 (durable-only resume).
- Aliases: REQ-XA-010 (declared run inputs — packet records, no absolute
  paths), REQ-XB-012 (deterministic outcome mapping).
- Contributing: REQ-XB-104 (process topology: one worker per attempt, sole
  writers, cross-process read/second-writer evidence; R6.16-owned full leg
  stays open).
